> so for week 5 freestyle i made a macro pad, looks only. its a display model, twelve keys in a 3 by 4 grid plus a scroll wheel on the side, no screen cause i wanted it clean. black keycaps with line icons, silver plate, silver metal scroll wheel. the switches just clip into the plate and hold the keycaps, no soldering, no pcb. the wheel is a mouse scroll wheel sitting in a slot on the right edge, it just has to look good. nothing here is wired up and it does not work as a keyboard. the look is the whole point, minimal black and silver, tight spacing, small margins.

## Design

### 2026-11-07: so for week 5 freestyle i started on a macro pad. twelve keys in a 3 by 4 grid plus one big knob on the side, no screen cause i wanted it clean. white keycaps, silver case, silver metal knob. linear s

**10h**

so for week 5 freestyle i started on a macro pad. twelve keys in a 3 by 4 grid plus one big knob on the side, no screen cause i wanted it clean. white keycaps, silver case, silver metal knob. linear switches so its smooth and quiet and theyre hot swap.

i wired it direct, one wire per key, no matrix, no diodes. layer one is editing and media, hold the bottom right key for layer two, volume and system. the knob does volume or scrub and pushing it mutes.

so far i drew the layout, schematic, and pinout, and wrote a firmware outline. nothing is built or tested yet, this is design only.

the board is a pimoroni pico lipo 16mb, usb-c, 15.95 in stock. the encoder is a bourns pec11r, 2.69 on digikey. switches are gateron yellow ks-9, 2.70 per 10 pack, sockets kailh 3.49, both kono, but the kono cart failed again, so that choice is still open. the iron is a jamcorax 9-in-1, 11.29.

the pcb is 112 by 70mm, gerbers are made, jlcpcb quoted 7.80 for the boards, 16.38 landed cheapest. the plate is the same size, sendcutsend quoted 11.63. both are quotes only, nothing ordered.

hours: 10

### 2026-11-08: so after entry 1 i got the repo up. made it public, pushed everything in, readme, bom, pinout, firmware outline, pcb and gerbers, plate dxf, and the cart screenshots. then i linked it on the half life

**7h**

so after entry 1 i got the repo up. made it public, pushed everything in, readme, bom, pinout, firmware outline, pcb and gerbers, plate dxf, and the cart screenshots. then i linked it on the half life project page and the repo checks all passed, it said everything this week needs is in the repo. the readme had no photos counted at first, so i embedded the layout and the schematic at the top and that cleared it.

then i posted the 5 hour reel, 24 seconds, same voice as the idea reel. half life only, no instagram. that unlocked submit.

the switches and sockets are kono, decided. i will take the kono cart screenshots myself and enter the bom in half life myself. aliexpress was the other option and i dropped it. the usb-c cable is mine, i already own one, so no cable line in the bom.

i am going tier 3 now, 100 and needs 20 hours. i have 10 hours logged, so this entry takes it to 17, still 3 hours to go for tier 3. i also want free shipping, no digikey. i checked for free shipping for the exact parts first. no verified free shipping for the exact parts at this order size, the us shops all want a big order for free shipping. newark has the same encoder for 2.41 but shipping is 9.99, so that is not free either. so i am going aliexpress generic for both lines instead, encoder and knob together 8.73 in the live cart with free shipping. the encoder came through at 1.09 but the knob was 7.64 in the cart, not 1.09. that still fits tier 3 fine. the encoder is generic, not the exact bourns one, so that is the tradeoff.

### 2026-11-08: so i changed the plan for week 5. the pad does not need to work anymore, it just has to look good. no wiring, no board, no pcb, just a display model. the hours are already past the minimum, so tier 1

**6h**

so i changed the plan for week 5. the pad does not need to work anymore, it just has to look good. no wiring, no board, no pcb, just a display model. the hours are already past the minimum, so tier 1 still fits, and the parts are cheaper now.

the look is a silver plate, black keycaps with little grey line icons instead of words, and a silver mouse wheel sticking out of a slot on the right edge instead of a round knob. the wheel is a real mouse wheel, about 25 mm, and the encoder under it is 11 mm.

i updated the project description to say it is a display model, and redid the readme and the bom to match. the bom is 28.77 for tier 1, plate, switches, wheel, encoder, and the black caps. the 15 hour reel is posted too. the bom still needs to be entered in half life.

hours: 6
